description: This file defines the implementation of the ConnectJob class in the net namespace, handling socket connection logic including timeouts, delegate notifications, and socket management for network connections.

classes.name: CommonConnectJobParams
classes.description: Holds parameters common to connection jobs, such as socket factory, resolver, and security settings.

classes.name: ConnectJob
classes.description: Manages the process of establishing a network connection, including handling timeouts, delegate notifications, and socket management.

methods.name: CommonConnectJobParams::CommonConnectJobParams
methods.description: Constructor initializing all parameters.

methods.name: CommonConnectJobParams::~CommonConnectJobParams
methods.description: Default destructor.

methods.name: CommonConnectJobParams::operator=
methods.description: Default assignment operator.

methods.name: ConnectJob::ConnectJob
methods.description: Constructor initializing connection job with parameters.

methods.name: ConnectJob::~ConnectJob
methods.description: Destructor that logs connection completion if still in progress.

methods.name: ConnectJob::PassSocket
methods.description: Returns ownership of the connected socket.

methods.name: ConnectJob::ChangePriority
methods.description: Changes the priority of the connection attempt.

methods.name: ConnectJob::Connect
methods.description: Starts the connection process, handling timeout and delegate notifications.

methods.name: ConnectJob::GetConnectionAttempts
methods.description: Returns connection attempts; default is empty.

methods.name: ConnectJob::IsSSLError
methods.description: Indicates if the error is SSL-related; default false.

methods.name: ConnectJob::GetCertRequestInfo
methods.description: Returns SSL certificate request info; default nullptr.

methods.name: ConnectJob::set_done_closure
methods.description: Sets a closure to be called when done.

methods.name: ConnectJob::GetHostResolverEndpointResult
methods.description: Returns host resolver endpoint result; default nullopt.

methods.name: ConnectJob::SetSocket
methods.description: Sets the socket and optional DNS aliases.

methods.name: ConnectJob::NotifyDelegateOfCompletion
methods.description: Notifies delegate of connection completion and logs event.

methods.name: ConnectJob::NotifyDelegateOfProxyAuth
methods.description: Notifies delegate that proxy authentication is needed.

methods.name: ConnectJob::ResetTimer
methods.description: Resets the timeout timer.

methods.name: ConnectJob::TimerIsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the timer is active.

methods.name: ConnectJob::LogConnectStart
methods.description: Logs the start of a connection attempt.

methods.name: ConnectJob::LogConnectCompletion
methods.description: Logs the completion of a connection attempt with error code.

methods.name: ConnectJob::OnTimeout
methods.description: Handles connection timeout, resets socket, logs, and notifies delegate.

methods.name: ConnectJob::OnTimedOutInternal
methods.description: Internal timeout handling, default empty.
